notes.text: DeepCool lists regional variants of the same unit (R-PK650D-FA0B-CN, -AU, -EU, -JP, -UK, -US, -AR, -BR, -WO, -BP, -BE); the US one is recorded.
DeepCool gives no Cybenetics rating for the PK650D; the page lists "80PLUS Certifications Bronze" only.
From "Type ATX12V V2.4".
From "Product Dimensions 150×140×86mm (W x L x H)".

DeepCool's power supply list files the PK650D under "Modularity: None" (its list item carries the filter class "ModularityNone"); the product page says "Black direct power cables help blend in with other components."

DeepCool lists connectors per cable and the cable count: "Main Power Connector 24 (20+4)Pin x1" X1, "EPS 12V Connector 8 (4+4)Pin x2" X1, "PCI-E (6+2)Pin x2" X2, "SATA x3" X1, "SATA x4" X1, "4Pin Peripheral x4" X1. So 4 PCIe (6+2) connectors on 2 cables (two per cable), 2 CPU (4+4) connectors on 1 cable, 7 SATA and 4 peripheral, and no 12V-2x6 or 12VHPWR cable. The manual's parts list agrees: PK650D/PK700D "D ×1 E ×2 F ×1 G ×1 I ×1", with "D CPU(4+4)Pin x 2", "E EPCI-E(6+2)Pin x 2", "F SATA x 3", "G SATA x 4", "I 4Pin Peripheral x 4".
From the manual's specification sheet: PK650D-F20 "Total Output 650W".
